names.note: Read out of saint.gr’s heading «Άγιος Διονύσιος Ιερομάρτυρας και οι μαρτυρήσαντες μαζί μ' αυτόν Φαύστος, Γάιος, Πέτρος, Παύλος, Ευσέβιος, Χαιρήμων και άλλοι δύο μάρτυρες».

death.note: saint.gr: «μαρτύρησε όταν αυτοκράτορας ήταν ο Ουαλεριανός (254 μ.Χ.)», of Dionysius, with whom his disciples died.

attestations.note: Read and not found: days.pravoslavie.ru's 3 октября ст. ст. (civil 16 October 2026) was read on 2026-10-04 and does not name him. His company is not absent from the Russian calendar, only from that day: four of them — Gaius, Faustus, Eusebius and Chaeremon — are kept on the Russian 4 October, read the same day. This stands undocumented rather than as a refusal, and whoever finds his own Russian day should look near the 4th.
Not on doxologia.ro’s list for 3 octombrie (checked 2026-09-17); no other day checked.
